name: hypersweeper
description: Classic minesweeper, but the board can be almost any surface and tiling — from a flat aperiodic Penrose mosaic to a Möbius strip.

paragraphs: Classic minesweeper, but the board can be almost any surface and tiling — from a flat aperiodic Penrose mosaic to a Goldberg sphere or a Möbius strip.
Play in the browser: (the TypeScript/WebGL app in web/, deployed from master by GitHub Actions; installable, and it works offline once loaded)

whatItDoes.text: Classic minesweeper, but the board can be almost any surface and tiling — from a flat aperiodic Penrose mosaic to a Goldberg sphere or a Möbius strip.

requirements.text: No account, no cookie, no identifier, and nothing about the request itself (no IP, no country, no user agent), so there is no way to link two games.
